theme_strategy.description: E-Kertalangu requires a sophisticated Light/Dark mode toggle to cater to all lighting conditions, from daytime outdoor activities in Kertalangu to evening religious gatherings. The design rejects the generic purple-white tech aesthetic, opting for an organic, deep, earthy palette infused with Gen-Z minimalism.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy with a Gen-Z Brutalist edge
colors.guidelines: Use the success color (#10B981) specifically for 'Hadir' status in attendance as requested. Secret tagging should use subtle border glowing effects with the accent color. Do not use pure black or pure white; always tint with the earthy green base.

headings.usage: Use tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers. Radical weight contrast.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for dense tables and forms.

mono.usage: For QR Code IDs, participant tags, and timestamps.

layouts.general: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Bordered items MUST have internal padding.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid for Admin/Pengurus dashboards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full to stretch children.
layouts.bento_grid: For Peserta view (participant self-service), use a Tetris/Bento layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8) to make personal info, QR code, and recent attendance feel like a modern poster.
layouts.navigation: Sticky sidebar for desktop Admin, sticky bottom floating nav with crystal glassmorphism for mobile Peserta view.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mix Flat Solid surfaces with 1px borders for functional dashboard areas. Use Neumorphism (Clay & Crisp) selectively for main action buttons (like QR Scan).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Optical Clarity' glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 with 1px subtle inner stroke) only for floating navigation and sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffused ambient shadows for cards. Deep shadows for floating action buttons (FAB).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero or login background to break digital flatness and give a raw, authentic Gen-Z vibe.
visual_enhancers.qr_code: Display QR codes inside a card with rounded-3xl corners, plenty of white space padding, and a subtle pattern behind the card.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions, sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-lg) for secondary data actions. Interaction animations (scale-95 on active) are mandatory.
components.inputs: Large hit areas (h-12 or h-14). 1px border. Focus states must have ring-2 ring-primary offset-2.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (max 12px border-radius). Use 1px solid stroke instead of heavy drop shadows.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables. Sticky headers. Row hover state should slightly shift background color and reveal quick action icons.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop must blur the background (backdrop-blur-sm).
components.charts: Recharts for attendance history. Use the earthy palette. Remove grid lines for a cleaner, minimalist look.
components.toast: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., successful QR scan, WhatsApp sent, autosave). Position bottom-center for mobile, bottom-right for desktop.
components.dropdowns: Shadcn Select. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds.

motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion for soft fade and slide-up (y: 10, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1) on page mount.
motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must respond on hover. Buttons should slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) with customized transitions (transition-transform 0.2s ease).
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for activity logs and participant lists.

specific_features.attendance_status: Hadir: bg-success/10 text-success border border-success/20. Izin: warning. Alpha: danger.
specific_features.quick_search: Sticky search bar at the top of lists. Trigger with Cmd/Ctrl + K.
specific_features.time_picker: Dropdowns constrained to 10-minute increments. Add WITA timezone label clearly next to it.
specific_features.whatsapp_sender: Modal presenting predefined pills (Rekap Harian, Mingguan, dll) for quick selection before redirecting to wa.me.
specific_features.secret_tagging: Small glowing dot or dashed-border badge that is visually distinct but doesn't shout 'SECRET'.
specific_features.musyawarah_editor: Rich text area with a subtle 'Autosaving...' indicator in the top right corner. Use sonner for 'Saved' toast.
specific_features.gps_picker: Minimalist map integration. The container must have rounded corners and overflow-hidden.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Focus states are mandatory (ring).
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid to all core interactive elements (e.g., qr-scanner-btn, participant-search-input, wa-template-btn).

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all standard icons. Consider @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) if a more premium look is desired.

login_background.description: Interior view of a modern mosque featuring unique geometric patterns and arches. Use as a split-screen background for the desktop login page with a heavy overlay.

hero_texture.description: Detailed close-up of dark green fabric. Use as a masked texture for dark mode headers or cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Avoid default Tailwind blues/purples.
Implement the font pairs (Cabinet Grotesk + Satoshi) using @fontsource or Google Fonts.
Ensure all Shadcn components are modified to reflect the earthy, brutalist Gen-Z vibe (adjust border radiuses, remove standard drop shadows for 1px borders).
Use grid-cols-1 on mobile for everything, scaling to bento or dense grids on desktop.
Build the dashboard-heavy Admin views emphasizing data density, but keep the Peserta (Jamaah) view extremely simple and card-based.
For the QR code generator, ensure the output has a clean, high-contrast white background so it scans reliably, even in dark mode.
Ensure the Activity Management time dropdowns explicitly snap to 10-minute intervals.
Add 'WITA' text indicator next to time inputs to prevent timezone confusion.
WhatsApp templates must format the message properly with URL encoding before opening wa.me.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but prefer sharp 1px borders over blurry shadows for this specific archetype.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
